F-35 Parts Detoured to Hong Kong Due to Missed Logistics Email

Parts for the F-35 fighter jet were rerouted to Hong Kong after a UPS worker missed a logistics email, according to reports. This detour reportedly allowed China to obtain the F-35 components. The incident involved a "risky Hong Kong detour" for the defense equipment.
